Abhijeet Dipke Faces FIR, Accusations Amidst Degree Challenge to PM Modi

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has been named in an FIR filed in Delhi following a complaint by social media influencer Faizan Ansari. Ansari alleged that Dipke is a "Pakistani agent" and accused him of inciting riots. Dipke, in turn, has challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to reveal his university degree, linking it to a debate on foreign education. Dipke also reportedly made a demand regarding PM Modi's social media reels and commented on a video of an apology.
